dedupe_keys.name: data and code for hospital acceptance friction and delayed ambulance scene arrival a prefecture year panel study in japan 2014 2024

description: Haruki Saito and Tetsuya Ohira at Fukushima Medical University publish a prefecture-year panel linking hospital-acceptance friction with delayed ambulance scene arrival in Japan. The data cover 2014 to 2024 and are accompanied by R analysis code, result tables, figures and reproducibility logs. Zenodo preserves version 1.0.0 of the linked repository as a ZIP archive. The deposited description specifies CC BY 4.0 for data and documentation and MIT for code, allowing free reuse. Annual prefectural observations could help check relationships between hospital congestion and emergency-service performance in a simulation. They cannot identify individual ambulance journeys or resolve within-day delays. The short repository description does not list the full variable definitions or establish causality; no analyses were rerun. No related catalogue record is identified by the deposit.
